biological_reference.closest_mechanism: locus-coeruleus noradrenergic gain modulation (Aston-Jones/Cohen adaptive gain)
biological_reference.divergence: The concentration premise is a control-theoretic reading of gain. In this substrate the modulator acts on an ADMISSION threshold, which broadens the committed population and dilutes the incumbent -- the opposite sign to concentration.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-20 (failure autopsy, cluster V3-EXQ-785a/785b): under EXOGENOUS urgency at the harm_weighted incumbent the V3-EXQ-785 profile is inert -- var_total fold 0.970 (vs 785's endogenous 14.1x), var rho -0.086 and share rho +0.31 against a pre-registered +0.6, gap +0.0036 against +0.02, 6/6 preconditions met, non_degenerate true. The null is tight rather than underpowered. Eliminates both H-arousal-concentrates and H-arousal-broadens.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: Every precondition is green on both scored arms; nothing is blocked on substrate. The bottleneck is the claim's framing, routed to /claim-synthesis.

re_derive_brake.note: 0 substrate_ceiling hits for MECH-463 under the R1-R3 convention. These are standard nulls with passing controls, not ceilings.

learning_extracted: A share-based criterion and its denominator can move in opposite directions: 785's total rose 14.1x while the incumbent share fell. Always record and read the denominator of a share criterion.
Exogenous manipulation of a driver that co-varies endogenously is the discriminating design, and here it inverted the verdict a strong endogenous covariation had suggested.

A modulator acting on an ADMISSION threshold dilutes rather than concentrates. Where a claim's prediction depends on the sign of a threshold effect, check the parameter's direction in the code before queuing.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: locus-coeruleus noradrenergic gain modulation, channel-agnostic form
biological_reference.divergence: Same admission-threshold sign inversion as 785a, now shown to hold at two further incumbent identities.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-20 (failure autopsy, cluster V3-EXQ-785a/785b): the channel-AGNOSTIC half of MECH-463 is now tested and fails. At the residue_weighted AND f incumbents under exogenous urgency, var_total fold 1.078 and share rho -0.143 against +0.6; 8/8 preconditions met on BOTH arms (per_arm_gate.all_green), 1757 committed ticks, 6 populated urgency levels, exogenous assignment fidelity 5.6e-17, randomisation orthogonal to hazard proximity at 0.066 against a 0.25 ceiling, non_degenerate true on all three criteria. Arousal's causal inertness on committed-selection variance geometry is channel-agnostic, closing the half the V3-EXQ-785 autopsy recorded as open.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: 8/8 preconditions green on both arms. No substrate gap; the residual is a claim-framing problem.

re_derive_brake.note: Brake does not fire (0 ceiling hits), but this autopsy independently REFUSES a further exogenous letter on the arousal/selection axis: three manipulations at three incumbent identities have returned flat with passing expressivity and fidelity controls. Another letter would be circling. A redesign asking a DIFFERENT question (what endogenous urgency was tracking) under a new EXQ number is not refused.

learning_extracted: An expressivity positive control is what converts a null into a verdict: 787's control (log10 var span 1.35, per-seed monotone fraction 1.0) is why 'flat' reads as flat_with_expressive_channel rather than as an uninterpretable non-result.

A frozen rival set can be exhausted while the phenomenon stays real. All registered hypotheses are eliminated and 785's endogenous 14.1x still needs an explanation -- a mystery (known data) node, where more runs on the same axis will not settle it.

Randomising the manipulation orthogonally to a known rival driver (hazard proximity, corr 0.066) buys independent immunity to that confound within the same run, rather than deferring it to a separate elimination experiment.

cluster_pattern.shape: Exogenous manipulation of every registered driver leaves both halves of the V3-EXQ-785 selection-variance profile flat, at three incumbent identities (harm_weighted, residue_weighted, f) and on two distinct drivers (urgency, hazard proximity), with passing expressivity and fidelity controls throughout.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The endogenous urgency-variance covariation measured in V3-EXQ-785 is not causal in either direction MECH-463 proposes. Something co-varies with endogenous urgency and drives the variance profile; arousal itself does not, and hazard geometry does not. The claim names the wrong causal agent, and fuses two premises (amplification, concentration) that V3-EXQ-785 demonstrated dissociate.

readings_refuted.test_design_ceiling: refuted by 787's passing expressivity positive control and by 785's own 14.1x on the identical statistic
readings_refuted.substrate_enrichment: refuted by 8/8 preconditions green on both 785b arms

granularity_debt_trigger.basis: Third autopsy circling MECH-463, each with a different failure signature (measurement_test_design_defect; standard null on hazard geometry; standard null on arousal channel-agnostically). Judged a genuine granularity signal: the claim fuses amplification with concentration, 785 showed the two dissociate, and the surviving question has no pre-registered candidate left.
